messages.subject: Truncated distributions in INLA
parts:
Hi,

Is there any way of using truncated distributions in INLA? I have a problem that requires a truncated Normal
(well, a multivariate truncated Normal) and I cannot find any information about using
truncated distributions with INLA.

I have tried to come up with some trick to get this done but I have
not been able to do so.

Best regards,

Virgilio

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Truncated distributions in INLA

no, that is not possible
